propositions: CodeHealthConfig.enabled field is declared but never read anywhere in src/rebar, making it inert despite being settable and documented
Structural metrics (module_size_distribution, oversized_module_count, complexity_summary, duplication_summary) evaluate unconditionally regardless of the enabled flag value
The inert-config gate cannot detect this field because enabled is read on other configs (ui.enabled, LangfuseConfig) so it passes globally despite being unread in code_health context
Operator ruled to DELETE CodeHealthConfig.enabled rather than honor it, removing the only advertised off switch for the code-health subsystem
Removal requires adding warn-class tombstones for code_health.enabled cfg key and REBAR_CODE_HEALTH_ENABLED env var to prevent silent drops and satisfy config-surface golden test constraints
